column1: # serde_points.tsv: exact bincode 1.3 (bincode::serialize, fixint little-endian) bytes of group elements and scalars.
# Both Affine and Projective serialize through GroupEncoding::to_bytes as a fixed-size array (serde_arrays, no length prefix): 32 bytes, identical to the compressed encoding.
# This is how nova's Commitment<E> (field `comm: E::GE`), the commitment-key generators (Vec<Affine>) and every point in proofs are written.
# affine|proj P bytes(32) ; affine_vec5 P,P,P,P,P bytes (u64 LE count = 5, then 5*32) ; scalar k bytes(32) ; scalar_vec4 k,k,k,k bytes (u64 LE count, then 4*32)
